title: Check that my database still protects memories, continuity and its own functions
why: On 2026-11-23 my trigger functions were locked so nobody can call them through the API, and my deletions became permanent through tombstones. This replays every one of those guarantees against a throwaway Postgres on this machine, so I can prove them again after any change to supabase/migrations without touching the real project.

steps.title: Replay the 2026-11-23 migrations and 64 security assertions in an isolated Postgres
steps.why: Needs PostgreSQL server binaries (PG_BIN or /usr/lib/postgresql/<n>/bin). It builds its own cluster in a temp folder, rolls every test back and deletes the cluster; it cannot reach Supabase.

steps.title: Compare with production, read-only
steps.why: Ask whoever holds the Supabase connection to run the catalogue queries in docs/production/2026-11-23-security-closure.md section 9 and the security advisor. Never write test rows into production; the only accepted live behaviour probe is the temporary-table probe there, which always ends in a rollback.
